changes: Defer rendering until loaded with a positive finite viewport and page size.
Retry rendering when Loaded or SizeChanged supplies a valid viewport.
Make disposal idempotent and ignore delayed PDF loads after disposal.
Reuse the unchanged official HTML renderer with an 800 by 520 DIP initial viewport fitted to 70 percent of the monitor work area.
Restore compact normal bounds once per HTML preview, including navigation from a manually enlarged preview; leave subsequent manual resize and maximize unrestricted.
Cancel deferred HTML geometry work when its plugin is cleaned up.
Preserve explicit upstream F11 fullscreen during HTML navigation, using only public window properties.
